image_description: A black and white photograph of a large radio telescope dish. The dish is parabolic, supported by a complex lattice steel structure (truss work). A feed horn assembly is suspended at the focal point above the center of the dish. The background features a cloudy sky, and the foreground contains silhouetted trees, providing scale context.

The rim forms a smooth ellipse consistent with a parabolic projection, and the interior shading suggests a continuous concave curve without geometric warping.
